## Pull request overview

This PR addresses module resolution errors in the Next.js documentation site by removing unnecessary fumadocs-ui component imports from MDX files and centralizing component registration in the page rendering configuration.

**Changes:**
- Removed redundant fumadocs-ui component imports from 449 MDX files
- Added Tab and Tabs components to the centralized MDX components object
- Updated webpack configuration to resolve fumadocs-ui component paths
- Removed experimental Turbopack configuration
- Simplified build script by removing NEXT_PRIVATE_BUILD_WORKER flag

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 300 out of 452 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| content/docs/references/**/*.mdx (449 files) | Removed redundant fumadocs-ui component imports that were causing module resolution errors |
| apps/docs/app/[lang]/docs/[[...slug]]/page.tsx | Added Tab and Tabs to centralized components object for MDX rendering |
| apps/docs/next.config.mjs | Updated webpack aliases to resolve fumadocs-ui components and lucide-react, removed experimental turbo configuration |
| apps/docs/package.json | Removed NEXT_PRIVATE_BUILD_WORKER environment variable from build script |

The webpack aliases use relative paths starting with `./node_modules/` which assumes a specific directory structure. This could break if the project uses workspaces or pnpm where node_modules might be hoisted. Consider using `require.resolve()` for more reliable module resolution across different package manager configurations.

The lucide-react alias points to the CJS (CommonJS) build, but Next.js prefers ESM modules for better tree-shaking and performance. Consider using the ESM build path instead: `lucide-react/dist/esm/lucide-react.js`.
```suggestion
      'lucide-react$': path.resolve(__dirname, './node_modules/lucide-react/dist/esm/lucide-react.js'),
```
